scope: Read-only audit for next implementation priorities; no new mechanical validation performed.
vehicle: 2000 Lexus GS300 / JZS160 / US / LHD / stock automatic / 2JZ-GE VVT-i

findings.finding: No complete component has measured geometry or physical fitment validation.
findings.consequence: Mesh count and recognizable appearance cannot establish repair readiness.

findings.finding: Timing pulley teeth, belt path and A650E clutch/planetary counts are procedural estimates.
findings.consequence: These details must not be treated as synchronization, rebuild or ordering specifications.

findings.finding: The fit check casts rays to the provisional hood only and checks selected v5 systems; it is not an assembly collision or clearance test.
findings.consequence: Passing this check does not establish mounting, underbody clearance, mating fit or tool access.

findings.finding: Inventory gaps mix absent geometry, unknown fitment, incomplete detail and unverified dimensions.
findings.consequence: 246 is a count of gap records, not the number of physical parts left to model. These pairs require reconciliation, not automatic gap closure.

findings.finding: Some sources are family-level or adjacent-year references; no actual reference-car build identity is recorded.
findings.consequence: Source applicability must be recorded at feature level; family evidence cannot silently verify the 2000 US variant.

findings.finding: Exploration offsets and hidden-part lists describe presentation states, not reviewed removal/reassembly dependencies.
findings.consequence: A service procedure needs separate dependency, fastener, connector, tool, fluid and verification records.

findings.finding: Validation currently checks metadata and selected counts; it rejects any part marked verified rather than testing evidence for verified status. No GitHub Actions workflow is present.
findings.consequence: Add evidence gates and automated regression reports before progressing to measured/validated parts.

findings.finding: 895338 triangles and a compressed file size are recorded, but device frame-time, picking latency and memory measurements are absent.
findings.consequence: Compression reduces transfer size; runtime responsiveness needs separate measurement.
